subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: GR1 'All references to identifier-2 and literal-1 apply equally to identifier-3 and literal-2' (cite.py --check 14.9.48.4 'apply equally to identifier-3 and literal-2' -> OK 14.9.48.4 1)). The binder folds every DELIMITED BY / OR item through ONE loop (dp.unstringDelimiterItem()) into one List<BoundUnstringDelimiter>; the emitter renders one string[]/bool[] pair and the kernel treats every index alike (GR9 zero-length skip, GR7 ALL flag, GR10 scan). No code distinguishes the first delimiter from the OR'd ones, so every rule over identifier-2/literal-1 applies to identifier-3/literal-2 by construction. Probe p2 T1/T2/T3 exercised OR'd literals with ALL on the second position: correct. No spec-derived test names this rule.
